reader.requirement: In a report with a PAGE clause no line of the report footing report group may be presented below PAGE LIMIT integer-1, for every Table 5 row (A R, R placed from FOOTING or from the page footing's final LINE-COUNTER, NP R); since every 1985 placement is fixed by the description (no PRESENT WHEN), the compiler must refuse a description that places a line past integer-1 (with §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR1) and present a footing that reaches exactly integer-1.

report footing UPPER limit: year<2002 seeds from the page footing's final LINE-COUNTER (NEXT GROUP included), else the page footing's last line; the LOWER limit is model.PageLimit at every edition
year>=2002 returns null; at 85 the walk of a relative report footing starts from the page footing's final LINE-COUNTER
year<2002 report footing returns PageLimit with 1985 rule words; later editions return the same lower (PageLimit) with 2023 words

reader.notes: Every Table 5 row with a PAGE clause is refused once any line passes integer-1, and a footing ending on integer-1 prints there. The absolute-line and A R/NP R refusals cite §2023 (SR6 c/d) at --std 85 and rf4's message mentions the page footing's LINE-COUNTER where none exists: wording only, the limit applied is the 1985 one.
